sum: FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. focuses on building an integrated Embodied AI (EAI), robotics, and intelligent mobility ecosystem. It develops and offers intelligent robotic systems, including humanoid robots, bionic robots, quadruped robots, industrial robotics platforms, educational and research robots, and Security and inspection robots; EAI Brain & developer platform; robot-enabled productivity solutions; and intelligent mobility and automotive technologies. The company has a strategic collaboration framework with Chutes AI to explore infrastructure support and technical integration opportunities for AIxC's AI agent and application-layer ecosystem. The company was formerly known as AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. in September 2026. FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in El Segundo, California.
ceo: Mr. Jiawei  Wang (CEO, Director & Principal Executive Officer)
